specs.Compatible Phone Models: iPhone 15 series, Samsung Galaxy S23, OnePlus 11, Google Pixel 7

features: 100W/5A Super Fast Charging: Konnect View 100W, a Type C to Type C PD cable, provides fast charging with a max output of 100W (5A) to charge all your Type C devices efficiently with compatible chargers.

LED Wattage Display: This USB cable has a real-time charging status LED display that lets you monitor the charging speed in watts. It lets you know if your device is charging fast or not and at what speed.

E-mark Smart Chip: Comes with an in-build E-mark advanced chip, which automatically adjusts the current and voltage your device requires to avoid any damage to the battery along with providing fast charging.

Unbreakable Nylon Braided Cable: This incredibly durable and tangle-free, 2m cable, is crafted with a nylon braided exterior and premium metal heads, and can withstand over 35,000 bends, ensuring a longer service life.

1 Cable for all Type C Devices: It is compatible with laptops, tablets, Type-C smartphones, earbuds, etc., that have Type C ports, such as the iPhone 15 series, MacBook, iPad 10, Samsung Galaxy S23, OnePlus 11, Google Pixel 7.
Data Transfer: Konnect View 100w cable supports data transfer, which means you can transfer data like videos, photos, files, etc. from one USB C device to another at a speed of 480 Mbps.
Portable and Versatile: With a convenient 2-meter length, this real-time monitoring Type C cable is perfect for use at home, in the office, in the car, during travel, and anywhere else you need it.
description: Portronics Konnect View 100W Type C to Type C Cable with LED Display with 5A Max Output, Fast Data Sync, 2M Length, Tangle Resistance supports Laptop Charging
